limits.resetPending: Waiting for the reset to be observed.

labels.noCombined: No combined.json yet. Run npm run tick, or wait for the next five-minute cycle.

status.hourlyUnavailable: Hourly totals are not collected yet
status.allUnverified: All needs verified records from every device
status.updateAhead: Update time is ahead of this device

sources.privateRefusal: A private folder check failed, so this source was not read.
sources.ancestorRefusal: A private folder check failed at a parent folder, so this source was not read.
sources.checkAhead: Check time is ahead of this device

tokens.partial: Covers {covered} of {total} tokens. Models without a price are left out.
tokens.deviceNote: Claude Code token totals are shown per device because Observatory does not check token overlap between devices.

activity.nowCaveat: Now adds the previous clock hour to the current one up to the last reading, so it covers 60 to 120 minutes ending at that reading.
activity.zoneCaveat: Days and hours follow the time zone of this computer, {zone}.
activity.noTracking: No tracking records for this date. That does not mean the computer went unused.
activity.foregroundNote: Screen time is recorded foreground time, not attention. Combined activity counts device overlap once.
activity.missingDates: Missing dates are Unknown, not zero.
activity.nowStale: The last reading is more than 10 minutes old
activity.nowHourAfter: No reading yet in the current clock hour
activity.nowNoHours: Hourly totals are missing for this period
activity.nowDaylight: Unavailable during a daylight saving change
activity.nowAhead: The last reading is ahead of this device's clock
activity.trackingRecentDetail: Tracking coverage was observed within 10 minutes of collection. It includes idle time as well as active use.
activity.trackingRecentCombinedDetail: At least one device had tracking coverage within 10 minutes of collection. This does not verify every device.
activity.trackingStaleDetail: No recent tracking coverage at collection. The device may be asleep or offline, or its watchers may have stopped. Saved history is kept.
activity.trackingUnknownDetail: Tracking freshness is unknown. Reading past records does not show that the watchers are running.
activity.trackingUnavailableDetail: Observatory could not read the source. Saved history is kept.
activity.help: ActivityWatch is a separate app. Install and run it on the device you want to track. Set screenTime to true in observatory.config.json. If ActivityWatch is already running, check that its local server answers on port 5600. Missing readings stay Unknown. Tokens and Limits work without it.

firstRun.title: Waiting for the first collection
firstRun.body: Observatory collects every five minutes while the menu bar or tray app is running. The first numbers appear here after that.
firstRun.hint: To collect now, choose Refresh in the menu, or run npm run tick in the Observatory folder.
